# Test DOWN action to see what it does
# First, save current state
curr_ascii = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

    return tuple(ascii_lines[r0+dr][c0+1:c0+6] for dr in range(1, 6))

# Check new state

print(f"\nAfter DOWN:")
for i in range(5):
    if curr_p[i] != new_p[i]:
        print(f"  P-{i} CHANGED")
    else:

        print(f"  SB-{i} CHANGED")
    else:
        print(f"  SB-{i} same")
